title: When hope meets cynicism: Annamalai’s new book talks of CJP, student protests and India’s fault lines

ai.summary: The book discusses student protests against the NEET paper leak turning into a crisis of trust in the system, highlighting how young people defend democracy when institutions fail.

facts.claim: student protests against the NEET paper leak began as an examination failure but turned into a crisis of trust
facts.quote: The epilogue to the book says that the student protests against the NEET paper leak began as an examination failure, but soon turned into a "crisis of trust".

facts.claim: the book states that the anger was not just about a single paper, exam or administrative lapse but about a deeper fear that the system had begun to betray aspirations
facts.quote: It asserts that the anger was not just about a single paper, exam or administrative lapse, but about a "deeper fear that the system which meant to protect aspiration had begun to betray it".

ai.background_note: The book links the NEET paper leak protests to broader systemic distrust in institutions, emphasizing how youth activism challenges political cynicism.
